personalInfo.name: Faizan Hameed Tantray
personalInfo.title: Software Engineer | Full-Stack Developer | Agentic AI Engineer
personalInfo.summary: Software Engineer and Full-Stack Developer with hands-on experience building scalable web applications, backend systems, real-time platforms, APIs, and production-oriented software. Strong foundation in TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, React, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, REST APIs, WebSockets, Docker, and modern backend architecture. Currently specializing in Agentic AI engineering, with a focus on AI systems capable of tool use, multi-step execution, state management, memory, planning, structured outputs, RAG, and reliable workflow execution. Founder and Lead Backend Engineer of Wolvinix and creator of BackendOS, an open-source backend framework/toolkit.
